analysis.title: Expense reimbursement policy
analysis.text:
EXPENSE REIMBURSEMENT POLICY
Effective Date: 2026-01-01
Employees must submit receipts within 30 days.
Manager approval is required for expenses above INR 10,000.
Meals are reimbursable up to INR 1,500 per person per day.

analysis.title: Leave policy
analysis.text:
LEAVE POLICY 2026
Effective from: 1 January 2026
Applies to: All full-time employees
1. Casual leave: 12 days per calendar year; cannot be carried forward.
2. Earned leave: 18 days per year; up to 30 days may be carried forward.
3. Sick leave: 10 days per year; a medical certificate is required for more than 2 consecutive days.
4. Leave requests must be submitted at least 7 days in advance, except sick leave.

analysis.title: Office IT & security policy
analysis.text:
OFFICE IT & SECURITY POLICY
Version 3.1 - Effective 15-07-2026
- Laptops must be locked when unattended.
- Passwords must be at least 12 characters and changed every 90 days.
- Personal USB drives are not allowed on office machines.
- Report lost devices to it-support@company.com within 24 hours.
